verdict.rationale: Supabase docs show a CLI (`supabase init/start`) designed to run the full stack locally or in CI (supabase-docs-21) and branching to test schema changes before merging to prod (supabase-docs-10/17/24), implying a migrations workflow, and probes confirm the CLI runs headlessly for scripting (supabase-probe-6/8). However, hands-on community feedback explicitly calls out migrations as Supabase's weakest area, with users forced to run migrations live in production despite the tooling (supabase-comm-7, supabase-comm-9 postmortem on backup/migration issues).
